verdict.rationale: Finix documents API-based seller onboarding, including building custom onboarding experiences, and offers hosted Onboarding Forms for teams that don't want to build their own forms. The evidence never details KYB/KYC verification, seller bank-account linking, terms acceptance, or embeddable components; the microdeposit item covers buyer bank payments, not seller onboarding. missing for 10: explicit KYB/KYC verification docs, seller bank account linking in the onboarding flow, terms-of-service acceptance capture, embeddable onboarding components, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can onboard a seller through the API — KYB and KYC, bank account linking, and terms acceptance — with hosted flows and embeddable components when I don't want to build the forms

citations.quote: Learn how to onboard your sellers with Finix's APIs.
